//: Committed template documenting every key the API reads. appsettings.json holds local values; appsettings.{Dev,Test}.json override them for the cloud environments. Values marked SECRET are never written in any appsettings file: they are files in the vault mount (Secrets:Directory), named with __ as the section separator, or user-secrets on a developer machine.

formatter.template: Text locally; one JSON object per line in Dev/Test (see appsettings.Dev.json)
